1.text: Bukeye Sawuli abwira umuhungu we Yonatani n'abagaragu be bose ngo bice Dawidi.

2.text: Ariko Yonatani mwene Sawuli yakundaga Dawidi cyane. Nuko Yonatani aburira Dawidi ati “Data Sawuli arenda kukwica, none ndakwinginze ejo mu gitondo uzirinde, wihishe ahiherereye.

3.text: Nanjye nzasohoka mpagararane na data ku gasozi aho uzaba uri, mvugane na we ibyawe, ningira icyo numva nzabikubwira.”

4.text: Bukeye Yonatani avugana na se Sawuli, amushimagiriza Dawidi aravuga ati “Nyagasani, ntuzagirire nabi uwo mugaragu wawe Dawidi kuko nta nabi yakugiriye, ahubwo imirimo ye yakubereye myiza cyane.

5.text: Yahaze amagara ye yica wa Mufilisitiya, Uwiteka atanga agakiza gakomeye mu Bisirayeli bose, ubibonye urabyishimira. None ni iki gituma ushaka gucumura ukavusha amaraso y'utacumuye, ugahora Dawidi ubusa?”

6.text: Sawuli yumvira Yonatani ararahira ati “Ndahiye Uwiteka uhoraho, ntazicwa.”

7.text: Yonatani aherako ahamagara Dawidi, amutekerereza ayo magambo yose. Nuko Yonatani azana Dawidi kwa Sawuli, aguma imbere ye nk'uko yari asanzwe.

8.text: Bukeye hongera kubaho intambara, Dawidi aratabara arwana n'Abafilisitiya yica benshi cyane, baramuhunga.

9.text: Bukeye Sawuli yari yicaye mu nzu ye afite icumu mu ntoki, Dawidi amucurangira imbere. Maze umwuka mubi uvuye ku Uwiteka ahanga kuri Sawuli.

10.text: Sawuli agerageza gutera Dawidi icumu ngo rimushite ku nzu, Dawidi ararizibukira amuva imbere rihama urusika. Nuko Dawidi aracika, arigendera muri iryo joro.

11.text: Sawuli aherako atuma intumwa kwa Dawidi ngo bamurinde, bazamwice mu gitondo. Maze Mikali muka Dawidi aramuburira, aramubwira ati “Iri joro nutiyarura, ejo uzapfa.”

12.text: Nuko Mikali amanurira Dawidi mu idirishya, agenda yiruka arahunga.

13.text: Mikali aherako yenda igishushanyo cya terafimu yabo akirambika ku buriri, yenda uruhu rw'ubwoya bw'ihene arushyira ku musego, acyorosaho imyenda.

14.text: Sawuli atuma intumwa gufata Dawidi, Mikali arazibwira ati “Ararwaye.”

15.text: Hanyuma Sawuli yongera gutuma intumwa kureba Dawidi, arazibwira ati “Mumuterure ku buriri mumunzanire mwice.”

16.text: Nuko intumwa zinjiyemo zisanga cya gishushanyo cya terafimu ku buriri, ku mutwe wacyo hari uruhu rw'ubwoya bw'ihene.

17.text: Sawuli abyumvise atonganya Mikali ati “Ni iki cyatumye umbeshya utyo ukarekura umwanzi wanjye, none akaba acitse?”Mikali asubiza Sawuli ati “Yambwiye ati ‘Reka ngende’. Nakwica nguhoye iki?”

18.text: Nuko Dawidi arahunga, aracika asanga Samweli i Rama, amutekerereza ibyo Sawuli yamukoreye byose. Bukeye ahagurukana na Samweli, batura i Nayoti.

19.text: Hanyuma babwira Sawuli bati “Dawidi ari i Nayoti i Rama.”

20.text: Sawuli atuma intumwa gufata Dawidi. Zihageze zisanga umutwe w'abahanuzi bahanura, Samweli ahagaze aho nk'umutware wabo, maze umwuka w'Imana aza ku ntumwa za Sawuli na zo zirahanura.

21.text: Babibwiye Sawuli atuma izindi ntumwa, na zo zirahanura. Arongera atuma izindi ubwa gatatu, na zo zirahanura.

22.text: Bukeye arihagurukira ajya i Rama ubwe, arasukira ku iriba rinini ry'i Seku arabaza ati “Samweli na Dawidi bari he?” Umuntu umwe aramusubiza ati “Bari i Nayoti i Rama.”

23.text: Nuko ajya i Nayoti i Rama. Maze umwuka w'Imana amuzaho na we, agenda ahanura kugeza aho yagereye i Nayoti i Rama.

24.text: Ahageze yiyambura imyambaro ye, ahanurira imbere ya Samweli arambaraye hasi yambaye ubusa, yiriza umunsi akesha ijoro. Ni cyo cyatumye bavuga bati “Mbega Sawuli na we ari mu bahanuzi?”
